name: Amarc Resources Ltd.
summary: Amarc Resources Ltd. is a Canadian firm specializing in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties throughout Canada. The company primarily focuses on discovering deposits rich in copper, gold, silver, and molybdenum, with wholly-owned assets including the IKE, DUKE, and JOY projects in British Columbia. Established in 1993 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, the company adopted its present name in January 1994, having previously operated as Patriot Resources Ltd.
